# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 73 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** P.Mich. 130, Shepherd of Hermas 73 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_073_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 8, Part 4 — The Commission and Departure

**73:1** "Lord," I asked, "those who surrendered green rods and whose rods were found to be green — who are they?" "These," he said, "are those who always feared God and kept his commandments and did not deviate in any way. They are the ones who will dwell in the first tower."

**73:2** After he had completed the exposition of all the rods, he said to me: "Go and tell all people to repent, and they will live for God. For the Lord, being full of compassion, sent me to grant repentance to all — though especially to those who have sinned greatly. For the Lord is willing that all who were called by his great and holy name should be saved."

**73:3** After he had finished speaking with me, the two young men who had accompanied him came and carried him away toward the east. And as he departed he was laughing. And he called out to me as he went away, saying: "Strive well."

**73:4** Then I awoke and wrote down everything that had been shown to me. And I was glad, for the things shown to me were great and glorious. And when I awoke I said: "The Lord has not forgotten me, but has shown me his grace."

---

*LOGOS renders according to the Greek text of P.Mich. 130 with attention to the commission formula and the departure scene concluding Similitude 8.*
